classified.text: The chief complaint is a 2-week history of a unilateral red eye with chemosis in a 67-year-old woman.
classified.rationale: It states a patient presentation and demographic detail as observed facts.

classified.text: The patient’s presentation is non-traumatic.
classified.rationale: It asserts the absence of trauma as a patient attribute.

classified.text: The patient’s presentation is painless.
classified.rationale: It describes a symptom characteristic of the presentation.

classified.text: The presentation makes common painful inflammatory causes of red eye such as scleritis, keratitis, or acute angle closure glaucoma less likely.
classified.rationale: It links the painless presentation to reduced likelihood of certain diagnoses.

classified.text: The key lesion on slit-lamp exam is a 7 × 4 mm conjunctival granuloma attached to the sclera with central epithelial necrosis.
classified.rationale: It contains a specific measurement and size-based claim.

classified.text: Salient positive findings strongly point toward a localized granulomatous reaction around a retained foreign body.
classified.rationale: It explains how the findings indicate a particular underlying mechanism.

classified.text: Ultrasound biomicroscopy showed a high-reflectivity echo embedded in the conjunctiva, episclera, and superficial sclera.
classified.rationale: It reports an imaging finding as an observed fact.

classified.text: Ultrasound biomicroscopy showed a low-reflective granulomatous mass surrounding the embedded echo.
classified.rationale: It reports an imaging finding without making a numerical claim.

classified.text: Ultrasound biomicroscopy showed multiple pseudocysts.
classified.rationale: It states an observed imaging feature.

classified.text: A discrete high-reflective focus within superficial ocular tissues is highly suggestive of foreign material rather than a purely inflammatory or infectious nodule.
classified.rationale: It infers that the imaging feature indicates foreign material instead of other causes.

classified.text: The surrounding granulomatous mass fits a tissue reaction to the embedded material.
